# Appendix A: Spyder Keyboard Shortcuts Cheat Sheet

Mastering keyboard shortcuts in Spyder 6 makes your coding workflow much faster. Here are the essential shortcuts for Windows, Linux, and macOS:

| Action | Windows / Linux | macOS | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Run entire file** | `F5` | `F5` | Executes the active script from line 1 to the end. |
| **Run current cell** | `Ctrl + Enter` | `Cmd + Enter` | Runs only the block enclosed by `#%%`. |
| **Run cell & advance** | `Shift + Enter` | `Shift + Enter` | Runs the cell and moves cursor to next cell. |
| **Run selection** | `F9` | `F9` | Executes only highlighted lines of code. |
| **Switch to Console** | `Ctrl + Shift + I` | `Cmd + Shift + I` | Moves focus to the IPython console. |
| **Switch to Editor** | `Ctrl + Shift + E` | `Cmd + Shift + E` | Moves focus back to code editor. |
| **Inspect Documentation** | `Ctrl + I` | `Cmd + I` | Opens function docstring in Help pane. |
| **Comment / Uncomment** | `Ctrl + 1` | `Cmd + 1` | Toggles `#` on selected lines. |
| **Indent line(s)** | `Tab` | `Tab` | Shifts code 4 spaces right. |
| **Unindent line(s)** | `Shift + Tab` | `Shift + Tab` | Shifts code 4 spaces left. |
| **Find and Replace** | `Ctrl + F` / `Ctrl + R` | `Cmd + F` / `Cmd + R` | Search and replace text. |
| **Set / Clear Breakpoint** | `F12` | `F12` | Toggles a breakpoint. `Shift + F12` sets a condition. |
| **Start Debugging** | `Ctrl + F5` | `Cmd + F5` | Starts execution in debug mode. |
| **Step Over** | `Ctrl + F10` | `Cmd + F10` | Executes current line and pauses at next. |
| **Step Into** | `Ctrl + F11` | `Cmd + F11` | Dives inside function call. |
| **Continue Debugging** | `Ctrl + F12` | `Cmd + F12` | Resumes execution until next breakpoint. |
| **Stop Debugging** | `Ctrl + Shift + F12` | `Cmd + Shift + F12` | Exits debug mode. |
| **Clear Console** | `Ctrl + L` | `Cmd + K` | Clears text from IPython prompt. |
